description: This file is an HTML document that defines the structure, style, and client-side logic of a web-based database viewer interface. It provides a user interface to browse databases, tables, and view table data with dynamic loading and interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the database list in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the database list, reloading data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and loads the tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the table data into HTML, including headers and individual cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell based on the value, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated content.
